findings.message: event 'bus.Changed' is subscribed (handler 'OnChanged') to 'Bus' — a DI singleton (application-lifetime) service that outlives 'Dom.View'; the strong subscription promotes 'Dom.View' to the source's lifetime, so it can never be collected — a captive/region escape (leak, no release path)
